business_identity.slogan: To inspire and nurture the human spirit – one person, one cup, and one neighbourhood at a time.
business_identity.description: Starbucks is a premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee globally, committed to offering the highest quality coffee and fostering human connection. Originating in Seattle in 1971, it expanded based on a vision to create a 'third place' – a sense of community between work and home – now operating over 15,000 stores in 50 countries.
